Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: tifu. i was in line at the gas station, waiting to pay for my soda and gas, when i saw a quarter on the packs of gum directly in front of the counter. when it was my turn to pay i bent over and scooped up the quarter, and put it in my pocket, forgetting about it instantly. putting my soda on the counter and reaching for my wallet, i looked up and saw the cashier eyeing me with an angry glare. i was confused by this. was she mad at my choice of soda? (she could be one of those freaks that prefer pepsi) did i have an offensive t shirt on? (not unless she's offended by my obscure podcast shirt) 

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Text: So I was walking back to my dorm after class last night, and I saw something that made my heart skip a beat. It was a guy playing the guitar on the street corner, and he was good. Really good. And then he finished his song and I went up to him and told him how much I loved their music, and he just smiled and thanked me. It was such a surreal moment, you know? Like, I never expected to hear someone play one of my favorite songs like that in real life.

Anyway, that's my story. What's yours?

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it.

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

Input: Text: last thursday i was given the ultimate dare by my friends - let's call them x and z. both of them instructed me to walk into the middle of the middle of the hall and yell out "allahu akbar" at the top of my lungs. i did it twice that day.

the first time i did it i made sure there were no staff around. then i walked into the middle of the hall and yelled it out. everyone laughed while x and z instructed me to do it again; i promised them i would do it on the second lunch break.

cut to the second lunch break.

halfway through the break, they reminded me to do it. again, i made sure there were no staff around before i yelled it out, this time louder than last time.

this is where the fuck-up happens.

after i said it i saw a teacher. he was just out of my line of sight.

"fuck!" i thought. there's no way i'm gonna escape this.

"what have you succeeded in by doing that?" he says.

"um, offending several people?" i reply.

"yes. yes, you did. now i'm going to have to inform the your guidance counsellor about this. you do understand that, correct?"

it was at this moment that i knew i could weave my way out of the situation by just ratting on x and z.

luckily it worked. unluckily they don't want to talk to me ever again.
Output: acted like a suicide bomber in school, lost two friends in the process.

Input: Text: so i was doing work for my boss by filing on excel i was working all day and it took me forever me being the idiot i am i don't save stuff periodically so i'm working away and at around 7 pm we get a power outage i freak out because i haven't saved yet then i bit on my computer and find that auto recovery in excel saved me! i am so grateful i even save. here's where i mess up when you save a file after a auto recovery it erases it from the recovery list so i work for another 10 minutes then turn my monitor off and watch a movie. when i wake up the next morning i am late so rush and leave the house completely forgetting about the usb i turn around and yank it out of my computer because i've done this millions of times why would it do anything now (spoiler:... it did!) so i get to work plug it in and windows say this directory is corrupt! currently using recuva by the same people who made ccleaner to try and save myself.

 

edit: got half of them back!
Output: was late and pulled out my bosses usb and corrupted the files

Input: Text: so to give my background, i go to a small liberal arts college in a freezing state.  since it's january we don't have much to do except well...drink.  now my buddies and i have a tradition, during the month of january we have a bucket list that's filled with debauchery.  from stealing tables in the cafeteria, getting peed of by someone or plain ole streaking, we have it all.

last night we were all kicking back having some delicious hamm's special light and i get the idea "hey i want to complete an item of the bucket list!" i get my phone out and scroll through the list till i reach [get hair cut by opposing team member.]  i think to myself "this is made for me!" i tell the boys at the party, which had around 30 or so people by this point and they get out the clippers.  after a few short minutes and everyone taking a swipe at my hair i end up with two mohawks, and not just any mohawks but the most uneven, messed up mohawks in my life.

i woke up this morning to go to work, i work as a tour guide, and the first thing my boss tells me to do is take off my hat.  she sees my hair and tells me how unprofessional i am and gives me a warning...and now i have to give a tour...well shit
Output: got drunk, let my friends cut my hair while they are drunk, now i look like a who from whoville.

outputs: Text: So I went to the doctor today and he told me I needed to lose weight. So I asked him if he could write me a script for some magic pills that would make me skinny without any effort on my part. He looked at me like I was crazy and said "I wish I could help you with that, but unfortunately there aren't any magic pills that can make you thin." I replied "Well, what about liposuction? Can't I just get that and be done with it?" He shook his head and said "Liposuction isn't a solution for weight loss either. It's a surgical procedure that removes excess fat from your body, but it doesn't address the underlying issues that cause obesity." I sighed and left the office feeling defeated. As I walked down the hallway, I saw a flyer advertising a new diet program that promised to help me lose weight quickly and easily. I thought to myself "This must be the answer to my prayers!" But then I realized that I would probably gain all the weight back once the diet was over, and I'd be right back where I started. Output: Went to the doctor and found out there are no magic pills for losing weight, tried to convince him otherwise, ended up leaving feeling defeated

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: this happened today. yeah.

edit: this posted twice on two of my accounts. sorry. 

anyways. so, my english teacher gives out an assignment every week with a certain prompt. each student must write a paragraph based off the prompt. this weeks prompt was, "which book character would you like to be friends with?" of course, to let some giggles out, i put down cinderella. which led to her probably being very kind to her being my girlfriend. and no, i don't fantasise about dating disney princesses. *which is exactly what i put on the paper to my teacher.*

i turned in the paragraph, and i come home from school and did jack fuck nothing as always. my parents get home and sit me down at the table. i got a lecture about what i like sexually. my parents said it was okay if i was into cartoon ladies. my teacher recommended school counselling, but no way jose. i'm not doing that. right now they're deciding whether i do or do not.
Output: cinderella, apparently, shouldn't be something i should be attracted to.

Input:
outputs: Text: I was sitting at work, minding my own business, when suddenly my coworker bursts into the room looking frantic. She informs me that she just saw someone walking their pet elephant through the parking lot. I can't even begin to describe how ridiculous this looks. Like, who walks their elephant?! It's not even legal to own an elephant as a pet where we live! I try to stay calm and ask her if she's sure it wasn't just a really tall person carrying a stuffed animal, but she insists it was definitely an actual living breathing elephant. So, I decide to investigate further and see if I can spot this mythical creature myself. As I step outside, I see nothing but a sea of cars and buildings. No sign of any elephants anywhere. My coworker starts getting upset because she's convinced she saw it and I'm not believing her. At this point, I'm starting to think maybe she's lost her mind. Suddenly, I hear a strange noise coming from behind me. I turn around and... holy shit, there's actually an elephant walking towards us! I can't believe it! I've never seen anything like it before. Output: Elephants aren't real pets, folks.

However, after warming up and getting harnessed up, I realized I forgot my climbing shoes at home. So, I had to sit there and watch as my friend and others went ahead without me. It was really frustrating because I felt like such a failure. But then, we took a break and I decided to try and make the most of it by taking pictures of everyone else climbing instead. And honestly, it was actually kind of funny seeing them struggle and hearing their grunts of effort. Output: Forgot my climbing shoes, turned disappointment into laughter by taking pictures of others struggling

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: tifu. i was in line at the gas station, waiting to pay for my soda and gas, when i saw a quarter on the packs of gum directly in front of the counter. when it was my turn to pay i bent over and scooped up the quarter, and put it in my pocket, forgetting about it instantly. putting my soda on the counter and reaching for my wallet, i looked up and saw the cashier eyeing me with an angry glare. i was confused by this. was she mad at my choice of soda? (she could be one of those freaks that prefer pepsi) did i have an offensive t shirt on? (not unless she's offended by my obscure podcast shirt) 

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

Input:
outputs: Text: I went to the grocery store yesterday evening after work, looking forward to buying some fresh produce and ingredients for dinner tonight. As soon as I walked through the automatic doors, I realized that I left my coupons at home. So, I decided to go back home instead of walking all the way back to the car. Little did I know, my husband has already started unloading the groceries without me. He even took the time to organize them according to what we need first. By the time I arrived, he had already put away most of the food and drinks. It was like he had planned this whole thing just to mess with me. I laughed so hard when I saw him sitting on the kitchen floor surrounded by our new groceries, looking very pleased with himself. My poor husband thinks he's so funny, always pulling pranks on me. Output: I forgot my coupons, came home to find my husband had already unloaded the groceries and organized them.

outputs: Text: I was driving down the highway when suddenly my car started making funny noises. At first I thought nothing of it, thinking maybe someone had left their trash can lid open near me or something. But then the noises got louder and more persistent until I realized I needed to get off the road ASAP. So I pulled over to the side of the road and turned off the engine. That's when I noticed smoke coming from under the hood. Great. Just what I needed. A blown engine on the side of the highway with no way to fix it. Luckily for me, a kind stranger stopped to help me out. He called a tow truck and even gave me a ride to where I could get a new part. I was really grateful for his help, especially since he didn't seem too bothered by the fact that my car was smoking like a chimney. Output: My car blew a motor on the side of the road and almost made me late for work.

Input: Text: this actually happened about 20 minutes ago? so yes, today. (do i get bonus points?)

my hair is currently down to my waist and obviously quite long. i keep putting off getting it cut though, because i haven't found a stylist in my area that i trust enough, so now it's at the point where i'll likely donate a chunk of it and get it styled, because it's so long.

i, also, currently hate my job and have a job interview on monday, go me! so of course to look more professional, i wanted to get my hair cut before then. (do you know where this is going? of course you do.)

so i'm in the office, sitting at my desk/open cubicle thing, and find a local place to call and try to find an appointment:

***
_m: "hi, i was wondering if you had an appointments available for saturday."_


_salon: "unfortunately we're all booked up, is there another day that would work for you?_


_m: "no, i work during the day [their hours are 9-5 on weekdays], and **i have a job interview on monday**, so i need to get it cut before then._
***
said in full earshot 

of multiple other employees. 

all the color drained from my face as the words were leaving my mouth. 

i've been looking for a job for months, but that doesn't mean i want to lose my current job before getting a new one...
Output: trying to get my hair cut. might actually be getting my job cut.**

outputs:
Text: So I went to the doctor yesterday because I had been experiencing really bad lower abdominal cramping and discharge for like a week. They did a urine test and blood test and said everything looked good. Then they did an ultrasound and found a mass on my ovary. Turns out it's a benign tumor and they will monitor it. But holy cow, talk about a rollercoaster of emotions! From thinking everything was fine to finding out I have a tumor. Ugh.

So yeah, I'm trying to stay positive and hopeful but man, it's hard. Like, I just want to be able to take care of myself without worrying about potentially having cancer. And honestly, sometimes I feel like I'm losing control of my own body. It's scary AF. Any advice or support would be greatly appreciated. Thanks for reading!

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

Input:
outputs: Text: I recently took my cat to the vet because he was vomiting frequently and losing weight rapidly. After running several tests, the vet informed me that my cat has hyperthyroidism. This means that my cat's thyroid gland is producing too much thyroxine, causing many problems such as rapid heartbeat, excessive thirst, hair loss, and muscle weakness. To treat this condition, the vet recommended medication that will reduce the amount of thyroxine produced by the thyroid gland. However, I was horrified when she told me the price tag of $200 per month! That's crazy expensive! So, I decided to look for cheaper alternatives online. After researching for days, I finally found a website selling generic hyperthyroidism meds for only $49 per month! It seemed like a steal, so I ordered them right away. Input: Text: tifu. i was in line at the gas station, waiting to pay for my soda and gas, when i saw a quarter on the packs of gum directly in front of the counter. when it was my turn to pay i bent over and scooped up the quarter, and put it in my pocket, forgetting about it instantly. putting my soda on the counter and reaching for my wallet, i looked up and saw the cashier eyeing me with an angry glare. i was confused by this. was she mad at my choice of soda? (she could be one of those freaks that prefer pepsi) did i have an offensive t shirt on? (not unless she's offended by my obscure podcast shirt) 

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: tifu. i was in line at the gas station, waiting to pay for my soda and gas, when i saw a quarter on the packs of gum directly in front of the counter. when it was my turn to pay i bent over and scooped up the quarter, and put it in my pocket, forgetting about it instantly. putting my soda on the counter and reaching for my wallet, i looked up and saw the cashier eyeing me with an angry glare. i was confused by this. was she mad at my choice of soda? (she could be one of those freaks that prefer pepsi) did i have an offensive t shirt on? (not unless she's offended by my obscure podcast shirt) 

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

i've been looking for a job for months, but that doesn't mean i want to lose my current job before getting a new one...
Output: trying to get my hair cut. might actually be getting my job cut.**

Text: So I was walking through Walmart last night and I saw something that made me realize how messed up our society has become. There was a mother and daughter shopping together, both dressed in matching sports jerseys and athletic wear. But here's the kicker - they weren't even related. They were just two strangers who met online and decided to dress up like each other for fun. As I watched them giggle and take selfies together, I couldn't help but think about how bizarre and sad our world has become. We used to value family and tradition, but now people will literally dress up as strangers for Instagram likes. It's like we've lost touch with what truly matters in life.

Anyway, I digress. What caught my attention wasn't just their strange outfits, but the fact that they were using a children's playground set as a makeshift photo booth. There were toy cars and dolls scattered around the area, and they were posing for pictures with these ridiculous backdrops. It was like they were trying to create some kind of absurd fantasy land, complete with props and filters. And honestly, I can't stop thinking about it. Why would anyone want to pretend to be someone else, especially in such an artificial way? Don't we have better things to do with our time than pose for silly photoshoots with stranger? Is this really what passes for entertainment in our culture? Output: Our society has gone mad.

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

Input: Text: tifu. i was in line at the gas station, waiting to pay for my soda and gas, when i saw a quarter on the packs of gum directly in front of the counter. when it was my turn to pay i bent over and scooped up the quarter, and put it in my pocket, forgetting about it instantly. putting my soda on the counter and reaching for my wallet, i looked up and saw the cashier eyeing me with an angry glare. i was confused by this. was she mad at my choice of soda? (she could be one of those freaks that prefer pepsi) did i have an offensive t shirt on? (not unless she's offended by my obscure podcast shirt) 

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

Input: Text: last thursday i was given the ultimate dare by my friends - let's call them x and z. both of them instructed me to walk into the middle of the middle of the hall and yell out "allahu akbar" at the top of my lungs. i did it twice that day.

the first time i did it i made sure there were no staff around. then i walked into the middle of the hall and yelled it out. everyone laughed while x and z instructed me to do it again; i promised them i would do it on the second lunch break.

cut to the second lunch break.

halfway through the break, they reminded me to do it. again, i made sure there were no staff around before i yelled it out, this time louder than last time.

this is where the fuck-up happens.

after i said it i saw a teacher. he was just out of my line of sight.

"fuck!" i thought. there's no way i'm gonna escape this.

"what have you succeeded in by doing that?" he says.

"um, offending several people?" i reply.

"yes. yes, you did. now i'm going to have to inform the your guidance counsellor about this. you do understand that, correct?"

it was at this moment that i knew i could weave my way out of the situation by just ratting on x and z.

luckily it worked. unluckily they don't want to talk to me ever again.
Output: acted like a suicide bomber in school, lost two friends in the process.

outputs: Text: I recently got a new job as a waiter at a fancy restaurant. One of my tables today consisted of four older women who seemed very proper and polite. As I brought their food and drinks, they complimented me on how well I was taking care of them. However, after I left to get their check, one of them accidentally knocked over their water glass, spilling it all over the table. When I came back to retrieve the check, they started laughing and pointing at the mess. They told me not to worry about it and even offered to buy me a new glass of water. But instead of being embarrassed or upset, I decided to play along and pretend that I was also a clumsy waiter. So I took a deep bow and said "My apologies, ladies! *giggles* It seems I've spilled quite a bit of water here! *chuckles* Don't worry, I'll make sure to clean it up right away!" They all burst out laughing and I ended up serving them the rest of their meal with a big smile on my face. Even though I was mortified, I couldn't help but laugh too. Output: Accidentally spilled water on customers, played it off as part of my service.

Input: Text: this happened either in the first or second week of school last semester. i had just gotten back from summer vacation and was excited to see all my college friends again, so naturally i went on about a week-long bender of getting piss drunk every night. following a long night at the bars i somehow made it back to my dorm and promptly passed out on the futon. now i should mention that i have an old george foreman grill that i use from time to time. it's a small dorm room so i have to keep it on the floor against the wall. so there i am sleeping soundly for a couple of hours before i woke up (still heavily under the influence) and had to use the restroom. i thought that i got up, walked out the door, down the hall, and into the bathroom to hose down the porcelain. however, as you might have guessed, that is not what happened. apparently, i got up, opened the electric grill, and relieved myself all over poor george as well as my wall. i don't have a roommate to confirm that is exactly what happened, but i quickly figured it out the next morning when i wanted to grill some breakfast sausage. 

in my defense the grill looks a lot like a toilet seat when it is closed.
Output: got drunk, urinated in a george foreman that i thought was a toilet

Input:
outputs: Text: I used to work at a movie theater, and one time we were having a slow day. So, I decided to have a little fun and started playing pranks on the customers. First, I would hide behind the ticket booth and jump out at them whenever they came in. Then, I would start talking loudly on the microphone, pretending to be the manager, and tell them something ridiculous like "Attention customers, due to unforeseen circumstances, we will be showing 'The Lion King' in reverse tonight". Some people would look at me like I was crazy, while others would laugh along with me. But then, things took a turn for the worse... One customer, an elderly woman, came in and sat down in the row ahead of me. I decided to take it up a notch and set off a fake fire alarm, thinking it would add some drama to the experience. Unfortunately, the lady ended up having a heart attack and collapsed in the theater. Panicked, I called 911 and tried to perform CPR until the paramedics arrived. It was chaos, and I couldn't believe what had happened. Lesson learned - never play pranks on innocent moviegoers again. Output: Prank gone wrong, almost killed someone

Input:
outputs: Text: So I decided to try out this new restaurant downtown that everyone has been raving about. It's called "The Sizzling Skillet". I walk in and it smells amazing. They greet me with a smile and show me to my table. I take a look at the menu and it seems pretty standard fare - burgers, sandwiches, salads etc... But then I notice something odd. All of their menu items come with a side of "Sizzlin' Sauce". Now, I'm intrigued. What could this sauce possibly taste like? Is it spicy? Is it tangy? I can't wait to find out. So I order my food and anxiously await its arrival. And let me tell you, when my burger shows up, it's piping hot and smothered in that mysterious sauce. As soon as I take a bite, I realize why they call it "Sizzlin' Sauce". It's literally just ketchup. Like, regular old Heinz ketchup. I can't believe I spent $15 on a burger only to discover that the main draw is a condiment. I'm still trying to figure out how to get my money back.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

***

of multiple other employees.

Output: trying to get my hair cut. might actually be getting my job cut.**

Input: Text: this happened today. yeah.

edit: this posted twice on two of my accounts. sorry. 

anyways. so, my english teacher gives out an assignment every week with a certain prompt. each student must write a paragraph based off the prompt. this weeks prompt was, "which book character would you like to be friends with?" of course, to let some giggles out, i put down cinderella. which led to her probably being very kind to her being my girlfriend. and no, i don't fantasise about dating disney princesses. *which is exactly what i put on the paper to my teacher.*

i turned in the paragraph, and i come home from school and did jack fuck nothing as always. my parents get home and sit me down at the table. i got a lecture about what i like sexually. my parents said it was okay if i was into cartoon ladies. my teacher recommended school counselling, but no way jose. i'm not doing that. right now they're deciding whether i do or do not.
Output: cinderella, apparently, shouldn't be something i should be attracted to.

Text: I am just gonna leave this here.

So, my boss asked me to organize a team building event for next Friday. As soon as he walked away, I thought to myself, "Team building? How cliché." And then I realized how ironic it was that I was thinking that exact same phrase while secretly planning a murder mystery game for our team building event. I guess you could say I'm feeling pretty "murderous" towards my coworkers lately.

I spent the rest of the afternoon brainstorming ideas for the game, including a variety of witty puns and clever twists. I even went so far as to create a fake crime scene in the conference room, complete with red herrings and misleading clues. It's going to be a real "whodunit" when everyone shows up to the meeting next Friday expecting a typical team building exercise, only to find themselves embroiled in a complex murder investigation instead.

As I sat at my desk, laughing maniacally to myself over my diabolical plan, I couldn't help but wonder what my boss would think if he knew the true nature of our team building event. Would he be horrified? Or would he see the humor in the situation and join in on the fun himself? Only time will tell.
Output: Team Building Event = Murder Mystery Game

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input:
outputs: Text: I went to the doctor yesterday because I thought I had broken my arm after falling out of bed last night. Turns out, I didn't break anything, but the doctor told me I have a rare condition called "Pseudoburrowing Syndrome". He said it's very common among people who spend too much time playing video games. I asked him what the treatment was and he said I just need to stop playing video games for a few weeks. So, I guess I'll be taking a break from gaming for a bit. It sucks, but I guess it's worth it in the end. Output: Video game addiction leads to Pseudoburrowing Syndrome. Who knew?

Input: Text: tifu. i was in line at the gas station, waiting to pay for my soda and gas, when i saw a quarter on the packs of gum directly in front of the counter. when it was my turn to pay i bent over and scooped up the quarter, and put it in my pocket, forgetting about it instantly. putting my soda on the counter and reaching for my wallet, i looked up and saw the cashier eyeing me with an angry glare. i was confused by this. was she mad at my choice of soda? (she could be one of those freaks that prefer pepsi) did i have an offensive t shirt on? (not unless she's offended by my obscure podcast shirt) 

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

oh wait, did i mention i'm still using my old email address for important things? yep, still rocking that bad boy. *facepalm*

Input: Text: last thursday i was given the ultimate dare by my friends - let's call them x and z. both of them instructed me to walk into the middle of the middle of the hall and yell out "allahu akbar" at the top of my lungs. i did it twice that day.

the first time i did it i made sure there were no staff around. then i walked into the middle of the hall and yelled it out. everyone laughed while x and z instructed me to do it again; i promised them i would do it on the second lunch break.

cut to the second lunch break.

halfway through the break, they reminded me to do it. again, i made sure there were no staff around before i yelled it out, this time louder than last time.

this is where the fuck-up happens.

after i said it i saw a teacher. he was just out of my line of sight.

"fuck!" i thought. there's no way i'm gonna escape this.

"what have you succeeded in by doing that?" he says.

"um, offending several people?" i reply.

"yes. yes, you did. now i'm going to have to inform the your guidance counsellor about this. you do understand that, correct?"

it was at this moment that i knew i could weave my way out of the situation by just ratting on x and z.

luckily it worked. unluckily they don't want to talk to me ever again.
Output: acted like a suicide bomber in school, lost two friends in the process.

I took a few classes, performed at open mics, and even got paid gigs – only to realize I suck at making people laugh. It turns out that being funny isn’t just about telling jokes; it’s about timing, delivery, and reading your audience. And let’s not forget about the crippling fear of bombing on stage.
So, after much soul searching, I decided to give up on my dream of becoming a famous comedian. Instead, I started writing articles about how hard it is to make people laugh. At least that way, I can still make people smile without having to deal with hecklers or the constant pressure to perform.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Text: So I went to the doctor yesterday and he told me I have a rare disease called Truman Show Syndrome. It's where I think I'm living in a reality TV show and everyone around me is an actor. He said I've been exhibiting symptoms for years, like constantly questioning what's real and what's staged, and always feeling like I'm being watched. But the good news is, he says I can get better with therapy and medication! Who knew being paranoid was curable?!

I couldn't help but laugh at his diagnosis, mainly because it explained so much about my recent behavior. Like the time I caught myself checking if the cameras on my ceiling were still recording, or when I convinced myself that the pizza delivery guy was actually an undercover producer. And let's not forget the countless times I've accused my roommates of being actors, only to realize they're actual people who just happen to live with me.
It's funny how something as simple as a medical diagnosis can make everything click into place. Now I finally understand why I've been feeling so disconnected from the world around me lately – turns out it's because I've been living in a freakin' TV SHOW this whole time! Mind blown.

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Text: I am writing this post because I have recently come to the realization that I may have accidentally become a cat lady.

I am 27 years old and live alone. I have three cats named Mr. Whiskers, Fluffy, and Puddles. They are all female and are approximately 2 years old. I adopted them from different animal shelters within the past year. At first, I thought having multiple cats would help alleviate loneliness, but now I find myself spending most of my time playing with them or cleaning up after them. My friends and family have noticed the sudden increase in cat-related content on social media and have begun joking that I am turning into a cat lady. I don't know what to say to them other than "blame it on the cats."

As I sit here typing this post, Mr. Whiskers is currently sitting on my lap purring loudly, while Fluffy and Puddles are curled up next to me fast asleep. It's moments like these where I feel truly happy and fulfilled. Despite the constant shedding and hairballs, I wouldn't trade my furry roommates for anything. So, if you're wondering why I suddenly stopped posting pictures of my attractive ex-boyfriend, it's because he couldn't compete with the adorable faces of my felines. Output: I may have turned into a cat lady, but at least I have my cats to keep me company!

Input: Text: well, a little context. i´m the kind of boy who needs to make experiments, to push a little the limits and i can´t stay without making something too much time.
a friend came with the idea of rockets : dude, i got this really cool project, we need household items and it´s going to be awesome!
we gather the materials, make the mix, cook it and burned it. it was awesome as he said and we make it like 3 times that day.
by this point he tells me that the mix can be used as fuel for rockets.
sooooo, this morning i just wanted to make some fuel. mix the ingredients, ready to cook in my kitchen.
maybe some glasses to look more professional? ok, lets do it.
so, there´s me, heating an inflamable mix.
then, it happens. a huge flame in front of my eyes. i move back and protect me, but it was instantly gone. the smoke covered everything, so i went outside to cough a little when my sister saw me. burned hair, the glasses were black, as my nose and forehead. my hand suffered the most and the house was filled with smoke (wich i didn´t know if it was toxic or not). 
never cooking again by myself.
Output: got burned cooking rocket fuel, filled the house with smoke

Text: I once tried to cook chicken using a pressure cooker, but things took a turn for the worse when the damn thing exploded all over my kitchen.
I remember thinking "oh great, another delicious meal ruined" as I frantically tried to clean up the mess. But little did I know, this would be the start of a series of unfortunate events.

And also, to keep a fire extinguisher nearby 'just in case'.

Text: I recently got an invitation to speak at a conference. It was quite unexpected since I don't consider myself an expert in anything. However, I thought it would be good experience so I agreed to do it.
I started preparing for the speech by researching and writing notes. But every time I tried to practice, I realized that I sounded more like a robot than a human being. My voice lacked inflection and emotion, and my words seemed dry and uninteresting.
I even recorded myself speaking and watched the video multiple times, trying to identify the problem. But no matter what I did, I couldn't seem to shake off the feeling that I was just a soulless automaton regurgitating facts and figures.
It got to the point where I was starting to doubt whether I was cut out for this whole public speaking thing. But then I had an epiphany - maybe I shouldn't try to be someone I'm not. Maybe I should just embrace who I am and let my unique personality shine through in my speech. So that's exactly what I did.
I stopped worrying about sounding perfect and focused on being authentic and engaging. And you know what? It worked! People responded positively to my speech, and I even received some great feedback. So if you're struggling with public speaking, don't be afraid to be yourself. It might just make your speech more memorable and enjoyable for everyone involved.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

outputs: Text: So I went to the doctor because I thought I might have food poisoning after eating bad sushi last night. He told me I didn't have anything to worry about and sent me on my way. Then he called me back 20 minutes later and said "I think you might want to go to the emergency room." Apparently I had a bleeding ulcer. They took me in and did some tests and found out that my liver enzymes were sky high. Turns out I've been living with alcoholic cirrhosis for years without knowing it. The doctor said I'm lucky I haven't died yet. Now I'm on the road to recovery and trying to stay sober. It's been tough but I know I can do it. Output: Went to doc for food poisoning, ended up finding out I've been drinking myself to death.

Input: Text: so i live in new york and it's getting a bit colder here so my fiancé kept asking me to take out the air conditioner.  we live in an apartment on the second floor.  i had just come off a 10 hour shift and i was pretty beat but i decided lets just get it done.  we slowly take apart the window and gently push it forward.  now here's the issue.  we had forgotten that it had rained yesterday so the air conditioner had  collected a bit of water.  it came pouring out and in the surprise we lost the grip on the air conditioner.  it plummeted out the window and went through a class covering over the stairwell.  it shattered.  needless to say its gonna be expensive to fix it and the owners weren't happy.  luckily there was nobody on the stairwell at the time.
Output: i'm and idiot and air conditioners are heavy

Input: Text: this actually happened about 20 minutes ago? so yes, today. (do i get bonus points?)

my hair is currently down to my waist and obviously quite long. i keep putting off getting it cut though, because i haven't found a stylist in my area that i trust enough, so now it's at the point where i'll likely donate a chunk of it and get it styled, because it's so long.

i, also, currently hate my job and have a job interview on monday, go me! so of course to look more professional, i wanted to get my hair cut before then. (do you know where this is going? of course you do.)

so i'm in the office, sitting at my desk/open cubicle thing, and find a local place to call and try to find an appointment:

***
_m: "hi, i was wondering if you had an appointments available for saturday."_


_salon: "unfortunately we're all booked up, is there another day that would work for you?_


_m: "no, i work during the day [their hours are 9-5 on weekdays], and **i have a job interview on monday**, so i need to get it cut before then._
***
said in full earshot 

of multiple other employees. 

all the color drained from my face as the words were leaving my mouth. 

i've been looking for a job for months, but that doesn't mean i want to lose my current job before getting a new one...
Output: trying to get my hair cut. might actually be getting my job cut.**

As soon as I entered the room, he looked up at me with a mischievous grin on his face and started rubbing against my leg. It was clear that he had taken over while I was gone and was proudly showing off his newfound dominance. I couldn't help but laugh at the sight of him, and I knew that he was going to give me a run for my money when it comes to training him not to jump onto the furniture.

outputs: Text: So I was walking home from work last night when suddenly I heard a loud crash behind me. I turned around and saw that a tree branch had fallen onto the road, blocking traffic. People started slowing down and pulling over to avoid hitting it. As they waited, a squirrel ran across the road and into the bushes nearby. Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

Input: Text: last thursday i was given the ultimate dare by my friends - let's call them x and z. both of them instructed me to walk into the middle of the middle of the hall and yell out "allahu akbar" at the top of my lungs. i did it twice that day.

the first time i did it i made sure there were no staff around. then i walked into the middle of the hall and yelled it out. everyone laughed while x and z instructed me to do it again; i promised them i would do it on the second lunch break.

cut to the second lunch break.

halfway through the break, they reminded me to do it. again, i made sure there were no staff around before i yelled it out, this time louder than last time.

this is where the fuck-up happens.

after i said it i saw a teacher. he was just out of my line of sight.

"fuck!" i thought. there's no way i'm gonna escape this.

"what have you succeeded in by doing that?" he says.

"um, offending several people?" i reply.

"yes. yes, you did. now i'm going to have to inform the your guidance counsellor about this. you do understand that, correct?"

it was at this moment that i knew i could weave my way out of the situation by just ratting on x and z.

luckily it worked. unluckily they don't want to talk to me ever again.
Output: acted like a suicide bomber in school, lost two friends in the process.

outputs: Text: I used to work with someone who always wore a suit every single day. It got to the point where I couldn't even tell if he showered because he smelled like fabric softener the entire time. One day, after months of putting up with his constant wardrobe choices, I finally snapped and turned to him during a meeting and asked, “Don’t you ever get hot? Don’t you ever want to wear something comfortable?” He looked at me like I was crazy and replied, “Of course I do! But this is what successful businesspeople look like!” Output: Successful businesspeople = smelling like fabric softener all day

Input: Text: this happened either in the first or second week of school last semester. i had just gotten back from summer vacation and was excited to see all my college friends again, so naturally i went on about a week-long bender of getting piss drunk every night. following a long night at the bars i somehow made it back to my dorm and promptly passed out on the futon. now i should mention that i have an old george foreman grill that i use from time to time. it's a small dorm room so i have to keep it on the floor against the wall. so there i am sleeping soundly for a couple of hours before i woke up (still heavily under the influence) and had to use the restroom. i thought that i got up, walked out the door, down the hall, and into the bathroom to hose down the porcelain. however, as you might have guessed, that is not what happened. apparently, i got up, opened the electric grill, and relieved myself all over poor george as well as my wall. i don't have a roommate to confirm that is exactly what happened, but i quickly figured it out the next morning when i wanted to grill some breakfast sausage. 

in my defense the grill looks a lot like a toilet seat when it is closed.
Output: got drunk, urinated in a george foreman that i thought was a toilet

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Text: I used to date a girl who had an odd habit of chewing her food twice before swallowing. It was super annoying because every time we went out to eat together, I would feel obligated to chew my food twice too just to avoid making fun of her. But then one day, I realized something - why should I care if she chews her food twice? Who cares if she has a weird habit? And honestly, it wasn't even that weird. It's liberating to not care what others think of us and just be ourselves. Output: My ex-girlfriend still thinks I chew my food twice.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input:
outputs: Text: Last night I had dinner with a friend who told me she had been struggling with depression since her mother passed away six months ago. She went on to say that despite therapy sessions every week and taking medication daily, things haven't improved much for her. As someone who has never experienced such loss myself, I didn't know what to say other than offering words of encouragement and empathy. However, after spending more time with her over the past few weeks, I realized that sometimes the most well-meaning responses can come across as dismissive or invalidating. So tonight, instead of simply saying "I know exactly how you feel," which may sound trite but also doesn't quite capture the complexity of grief, I decided to ask her questions that might allow us to explore each other's experiences together. Questions like: What are some ways that you've found comfort recently? How have you been managing your emotions during these difficult times? And what kind of support systems have you established for yourself? By asking open-ended questions like these, I hope to create space for deeper understanding rather than relying solely on pat answers or cliches. This approach may not make everything okay right away (and it shouldn't), but maybe we can learn from each other and offer meaningful support along the way. Output: Sometimes even the best intentions can fall flat, so let's try asking real questions instead.

Text: I used to think my cat was weird until I got a dog. Now I realize my cat is normal and my dog is insane.

For example, my cat will sometimes knock over a vase or scratch the couch, but when I scold him, he looks at me with these big, sad eyes and it breaks my heart. My dog, on the other hand, will rip apart a cushion or chew on a shoe, and when I scold him, he just keeps barking and wagging his tail like nothing's wrong. It's like he thinks I'm praising him for being destructive.

I've tried to train him using positive reinforcement techniques, but it seems like every time I give him a treat, he just becomes more and more hyperactive. He's like a little ball of energy that never stops moving. And when I take him for a walk, he pulls me along like a magnet, almost dragging me across the ground. It's exhausting.

Despite all this chaos, however, my dog has a sweet spot for belly rubs. If you rub his belly just right, he'll lean into your touch and close his eyes blissfully. It's the only time he's truly calm and content. But even then, he can't seem to resist giving me a playful nip on the arm whenever I stop rubbing his belly. It's like he's saying, "Hey, human, don't forget about me!" Output: My cat is normal, my dog is insane.

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.

Input: Text: last thursday i was given the ultimate dare by my friends - let's call them x and z. both of them instructed me to walk into the middle of the middle of the hall and yell out "allahu akbar" at the top of my lungs. i did it twice that day.

the first time i did it i made sure there were no staff around. then i walked into the middle of the hall and yelled it out. everyone laughed while x and z instructed me to do it again; i promised them i would do it on the second lunch break.

cut to the second lunch break.

halfway through the break, they reminded me to do it. again, i made sure there were no staff around before i yelled it out, this time louder than last time.

this is where the fuck-up happens.

after i said it i saw a teacher. he was just out of my line of sight.

"fuck!" i thought. there's no way i'm gonna escape this.

"what have you succeeded in by doing that?" he says.

"um, offending several people?" i reply.

"yes. yes, you did. now i'm going to have to inform the your guidance counsellor about this. you do understand that, correct?"

it was at this moment that i knew i could weave my way out of the situation by just ratting on x and z.

luckily it worked. unluckily they don't want to talk to me ever again.
Output: acted like a suicide bomber in school, lost two friends in the process.

Input: Text: so i live in new york and it's getting a bit colder here so my fiancé kept asking me to take out the air conditioner.  we live in an apartment on the second floor.  i had just come off a 10 hour shift and i was pretty beat but i decided lets just get it done.  we slowly take apart the window and gently push it forward.  now here's the issue.  we had forgotten that it had rained yesterday so the air conditioner had  collected a bit of water.  it came pouring out and in the surprise we lost the grip on the air conditioner.  it plummeted out the window and went through a class covering over the stairwell.  it shattered.  needless to say its gonna be expensive to fix it and the owners weren't happy.  luckily there was nobody on the stairwell at the time.
Output: i'm and idiot and air conditioners are heavy

Input:
outputs: Text: I used to work at a retirement home and one old lady would always ask me to play fetch with her dog. every time she asked, I would pretend to misunderstand and tell her I couldn't play because I had a meeting/appointment/emergency.
