Input: Text: this happened either in the first or second week of school last semester. i had just gotten back from summer vacation and was excited to see all my college friends again, so naturally i went on about a week-long bender of getting piss drunk every night. following a long night at the bars i somehow made it back to my dorm and promptly passed out on the futon. now i should mention that i have an old george foreman grill that i use from time to time. it's a small dorm room so i have to keep it on the floor against the wall. so there i am sleeping soundly for a couple of hours before i woke up (still heavily under the influence) and had to use the restroom. i thought that i got up, walked out the door, down the hall, and into the bathroom to hose down the porcelain. however, as you might have guessed, that is not what happened. apparently, i got up, opened the electric grill, and relieved myself all over poor george as well as my wall. i don't have a roommate to confirm that is exactly what happened, but i quickly figured it out the next morning when i wanted to grill some breakfast sausage.

Input:
outputs: Text: I used to work at a grocery store, and I remember one time when a customer came in with his kid, who couldn't have been more than five years old. The little boy looked up at me with these huge brown eyes and asked if I could help him find something. I immediately melted into a gooey mess because how can you say no to a child? So I told him I would definitely help him find whatever he needed. Well, it turns out that what he needed was a box of cereal called "Froot Loops." Now, I know what you're thinking... why is this funny? But hear me out. This kid asks for Froot Loops, and I start to ring it up, only to realize that the name sounds suspiciously similar to a certain body part. I tried really hard not to giggle, but let's just say I failed miserably. The kid looked at me with those big brown eyes again and asked if I was laughing at him. And I'm pretty sure I turned bright red and stuttered something about needing to scan the cereal real quick. It was mortifying. Output: Accidentally giggled at a five year old asking for "Froot Loopers".

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Input: Text: this happened either in the first or second week of school last semester. i had just gotten back from summer vacation and was excited to see all my college friends again, so naturally i went on about a week-long bender of getting piss drunk every night. following a long night at the bars i somehow made it back to my dorm and promptly passed out on the futon. now i should mention that i have an old george foreman grill that i use from time to time. it's a small dorm room so i have to keep it on the floor against the wall. so there i am sleeping soundly for a couple of hours before i woke up (still heavily under the influence) and had to use the restroom. i thought that i got up, walked out the door, down the hall, and into the bathroom to hose down the porcelain. however, as you might have guessed, that is not what happened. apparently, i got up, opened the electric grill, and relieved myself all over poor george as well as my wall. i don't have a roommate to confirm that is exactly what happened, but i quickly figured it out the next morning when i wanted to grill some breakfast sausage. 

in my defense the grill looks a lot like a toilet seat when it is closed.
Output: got drunk, urinated in a george foreman that i thought was a toilet

Input: Text: so i was doing work for my boss by filing on excel i was working all day and it took me forever me being the idiot i am i don't save stuff periodically so i'm working away and at around 7 pm we get a power outage i freak out because i haven't saved yet then i bit on my computer and find that auto recovery in excel saved me! i am so grateful i even save. here's where i mess up when you save a file after a auto recovery it erases it from the recovery list so i work for another 10 minutes then turn my monitor off and watch a movie. when i wake up the next morning i am late so rush and leave the house completely forgetting about the usb i turn around and yank it out of my computer because i've done this millions of times why would it do anything now (spoiler:... it did!) so i get to work plug it in and windows say this directory is corrupt! currently using recuva by the same people who made ccleaner to try and save myself.

 

edit: got half of them back!
Output: was late and pulled out my bosses usb and corrupted the files

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input:
outputs: Text: I was working at the office yesterday when suddenly I felt very unwell. My vision started blurring and I could feel my legs giving way beneath me. I stumbled towards the exit, hoping to make it outside before things got worse...but unfortunately, I didn't quite make it. As soon as I hit the parking lot, everything went black and I collapsed onto the ground. Luckily, someone found me shortly afterward and called for an ambulance. Turns out, I suffered a pretty bad panic attack and almost passed out cold. The paramedics showed up and took care of me, and now I'm laid up at home recovering. It's been a bit of an embarrassing experience, especially since I work in a relatively conservative industry where people tend to be more reserved and professional. But hey, at least I won't forget my lunch for a few days! Output: Almost passed out cold during a panic attack at work

Text: So I was driving home from work yesterday when suddenly my car started making this weird knocking noise. At first I thought it was just the usual creaks and groans of an older vehicle, but then the noise grew louder and more persistent until I could barely hear anything else. I pulled over to the side of the road and popped the hood, but everything looked perfectly normal to me. That's when I noticed the smoke coming from the engine. I panicked and called a tow truck, hoping that it wasn't too serious. When we arrived at the mechanic's shop, he told me that the problem was actually much worse than I realized - turns out my engine had been filled with catnip! Yeah, you read that right. Someone had secretly stuffed my engine full of catnip and now it was just randomly spazzing out on me. The mechanic said it would take a few days to fix, so I've been dealing with a very angry cat ever since.

Output: Got catnapped by a mischievous feline, now driving a cat-infested vehicle

Input: Text: tifu. i was in line at the gas station, waiting to pay for my soda and gas, when i saw a quarter on the packs of gum directly in front of the counter. when it was my turn to pay i bent over and scooped up the quarter, and put it in my pocket, forgetting about it instantly. putting my soda on the counter and reaching for my wallet, i looked up and saw the cashier eyeing me with an angry glare. i was confused by this. was she mad at my choice of soda? (she could be one of those freaks that prefer pepsi) did i have an offensive t shirt on? (not unless she's offended by my obscure podcast shirt) 

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

Input:
outputs: Text: So I was walking through the park today and I saw something that made me chuckle. There was a guy playing fetch with his dog...but here's the thing - he wasn't throwing a ball or frisbee, oh no. He was using a raw egg. Yep, he took an egg from the carton and tossed it across the field for his pup to catch. Now, I know what you're thinking - how did the egg survive the impact without breaking? Well, let me tell you, it didn't. As soon as the dog caught the egg, it cracked open and splattered everywhere. It was quite the sight to behold. I couldn't help but laugh at the absurdity of it all. Output: Guy played fetch with his dog using a raw egg, which cracked open upon being caught

***
_m: "hi, i was wondering if you had an appointments available for saturday."_


_salon: "unfortunately we're all booked up, is there another day that would work for you?_

***
said in full earshot 

of multiple other employees.

i've been looking for a job for months, but that doesn't mean i want to lose my current job before getting a new one...
Output: trying to get my hair cut. might actually be getting my job cut.**

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

Text: So I was browsing through TikTok yesterday evening and came across a video of a guy doing tricks on his skateboard while simultaneously playing the guitar. It caught my attention because he was really good at both things simultaneously, and I couldn't help but think how cool it would be if someone could do that in real life. Then I saw the comments section and noticed that people were saying things like "Wow, how did he even learn to play the guitar while skateboarding? That's insane!" And then I read further and found out that he actually learned how to do it by watching videos of himself playing the guitar while skateboarding. Like, who does that?! 

Anyway, I started thinking about how weird it is that we live in a world where people can become experts at anything they want just by watching YouTube tutorials. I mean, sure, it's great that we have access to all this information, but sometimes I feel like we're losing touch with reality. I used to love learning new things, but now I find myself wondering if I need to go outside and experience the world instead of just watching videos of other people experiencing it for me. Am I the only one feeling this way?

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow.

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

outputs: Text: I used to think that when people said they "had a lot on their plate," they literally meant they had a bunch of food on a plate. Then I realized they were talking about stress. Now I know what they mean. I have been dealing with anxiety and depression for years now, and it has been a real challenge. Recently, I started seeing a therapist and taking meds, and things seem to be looking up. But last week, I found myself sitting in front of my computer, staring blankly into space, wondering how I was going to pay my rent next month. Suddenly, I felt overwhelmed by everything - bills, work, personal problems, etc. And just like that, I broke down in tears. My partner came running and gave me a big hug, telling me everything will be okay. It took a few minutes for me to calm down, but eventually, I composed myself enough to explain why I was crying. We talked about our finances and made a plan to tackle them together. Sometimes, it takes a little bit of vulnerability and support from loved ones to remind ourselves that we aren't alone in this struggle. Output: sometimes, having too much on your plate means more than just food.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

I told him I didn't have enough money so he offered to finance it for me. I agreed and signed the papers without reading them carefully. A few minutes later, I realized that I had made a huge mistake by signing up for their financing plan. It turns out that the interest rate was way higher than what I expected and I would end up paying double the original price of the phone. I panicked and called the salesperson to ask him to reverse the transaction, but he refused. Now I'm stuck with a phone that I can't afford and a big financial burden hanging over my head.

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

She even threw in a dessert on the house. Output: Sometimes, being polite doesn't always work, especially when dealing with incompetent staff.

Input: Text: well, a little context. i´m the kind of boy who needs to make experiments, to push a little the limits and i can´t stay without making something too much time.
a friend came with the idea of rockets : dude, i got this really cool project, we need household items and it´s going to be awesome!
we gather the materials, make the mix, cook it and burned it. it was awesome as he said and we make it like 3 times that day.
by this point he tells me that the mix can be used as fuel for rockets.
sooooo, this morning i just wanted to make some fuel. mix the ingredients, ready to cook in my kitchen.
maybe some glasses to look more professional? ok, lets do it.
so, there´s me, heating an inflamable mix.
then, it happens. a huge flame in front of my eyes. i move back and protect me, but it was instantly gone. the smoke covered everything, so i went outside to cough a little when my sister saw me. burned hair, the glasses were black, as my nose and forehead. my hand suffered the most and the house was filled with smoke (wich i didn´t know if it was toxic or not). 
never cooking again by myself.
Output: got burned cooking rocket fuel, filled the house with smoke

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

cut to the second lunch break.

halfway through the break, they reminded me to do it. again, i made sure there were no staff around before i yelled it out, this time louder than last time.

this is where the fuck-up happens.

after i said it i saw a teacher. he was just out of my line of sight.

"fuck!" i thought. there's no way i'm gonna escape this.

"what have you succeeded in by doing that?" he says.

"um, offending several people?" i reply.

"yes. yes, you did. now i'm going to have to inform the your guidance counsellor about this. you do understand that, correct?"

it was at this moment that i knew i could weave my way out of the situation by just ratting on x and z.

luckily it worked. unluckily they don't want to talk to me ever again.
Output: acted like a suicide bomber in school, lost two friends in the process.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Text: So I went to the doctor yesterday and he told me I have a rare disease called Tourette Syndrome. I asked him if there was anything I could do to cure it and he said "well, there isn't much you can do, except for maybe try some deep breathing exercises". I replied "okay, cool" and then he proceeded to tell me that I also have ADHD. I was like "oh, okay, no problem" and then he said "and by the way, you also have narcolepsy". Output: Yeah, yeah, whatever, thanks doc.

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email.

edit: word choices and better spacing.

Input: Text: So, I decided to take matters into my own hands and bought a ticket to Hawaii. Why not, right? It's always sunny and warm there, perfect for getting away from the cold and dark winters of New York City. And besides, who wouldn't want to spend their vacation days lounging on a beach with cocktails and good company? Sounds like a dream come true, right? WRONG. As soon as I stepped foot onto the island, I knew something was off. The airport smelled like a combination of stale cigarette smoke and burnt rubber, and the taxi driver couldn't stop talking about how "the tourists" were ruining the island. Ruining it? How could they possibly be ruining a place that looks like it's straight out of a tropical paradise calendar? But no, apparently all these rich people showing up has driven up property prices and made it impossible for locals to afford basic necessities like food and housing. And then there's the issue of overcrowding and trash everywhere. Like seriously, where did all these people come from? Did they forget to tell us that Hawaii was now part of China or something? Anyways, I digress. Long story short, I spent my entire trip hiding in my hotel room, only venturing out for quick trips to the beach because I couldn't handle the constant harassment from panhandlers and street performers. And honestly, I'd rather deal with the freezing temperatures and snow back home than ever step foot on this godforsaken island again. Output: Vacation turned into nightmare due to overcrowding and harassment

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email.

Input: Text: well, a little context. i´m the kind of boy who needs to make experiments, to push a little the limits and i can´t stay without making something too much time.
a friend came with the idea of rockets : dude, i got this really cool project, we need household items and it´s going to be awesome!
we gather the materials, make the mix, cook it and burned it. it was awesome as he said and we make it like 3 times that day.
by this point he tells me that the mix can be used as fuel for rockets.
sooooo, this morning i just wanted to make some fuel. mix the ingredients, ready to cook in my kitchen.
maybe some glasses to look more professional? ok, lets do it.
so, there´s me, heating an inflamable mix.
then, it happens. a huge flame in front of my eyes. i move back and protect me, but it was instantly gone. the smoke covered everything, so i went outside to cough a little when my sister saw me. burned hair, the glasses were black, as my nose and forehead. my hand suffered the most and the house was filled with smoke (wich i didn´t know if it was toxic or not). 
never cooking again by myself.
Output: got burned cooking rocket fuel, filled the house with smoke

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Input:
outputs:
Text: I have been working at this company for almost three years now and every year around this time they start talking about "summer hours". supposedly starting in june, everyone will work shorter days and leave earlier. i have heard this rumor EVERY YEAR SINCE I STARTED HERE AND NOT ONE TIME HAVE THEY ACTUALLY ENFORCED IT. i mean seriously, what are the odds that they will suddenly start following through on their promises NOW? 
anyway, today i decided to test the waters and asked my manager straight up if summer hours were happening this year. his response? "well...let's just say we're gonna try our best." Ummm...okay...i think i speak for everyone here when i say WELL THAT DOESN'T GIVE ME MUCH HOPE. thanks for nothing buddy.
Output: Summer hours are always a myth where I work

Input: Text: background: i went to summer camp about two weeks ago and met a guy. it's long distance and we text every second we possibly can. 

      now fast forward to this week. i'm in my school's marching band, and our band camp started this week, which means i get the pleasure of spending six hours a day on my feet doing things that the human body was not naturally made to do. our rehearsals are in the mornings and late afternoons/evenings which means i get a couple of hours a day in which i can do whatever. well, i was supposed to do the work for my online class and practice my music for band, and i hoped to fit eating, napping and texting the bf in somewhere int those precious band-free hours.
      let's just say i managed to get plenty of time in texting the bf. i had done about half of the work that was due today, but had procrastinated in the rest. well, here comes 6 in the evening, and i realise oh shit i still have all this work to do. so i rush to try and complete all the work, and 11 rolls around, the cut off time for due dates.
      i think no problem i'll just stay up until who-knows-time of the morning, finish the work, and sneak it into the the system so that the teacher would see it in the morning. but just my luck, the system goes down for maintenance, and here i'm stuck with uncompleted work and no way to complete it. so i end up finishing the assignment that i have to do offline and submit to the system, and now i'm stuck with work that's going to be late and the only option i can think of is emailing the teacher in the morning and hoping he'll take my late work.
Output: texted bf, didn't do work, am now possibly screwed

outputs: Text: So I was at the grocery store yesterday when I saw someone who looked eerily similar to Tom Hanks. It was then that I realized how much I miss watching Forrest Gump. As we're about to start the movie, my roommate turns to me and says, "You know, I never understood why Jenny killed herself." And suddenly, the whole thing feels really dark and depressing. Anyways, we press on and manage to make it through the entire movie without any further discussion of suicide. But honestly, I think I might need therapy after that experience.

outputs: Text: I've been trying to lose weight for months now, but nothing seems to be working. I've tried everything under the sun - diets, exercise routines, pills, potions, you name it. Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Text: So I got home from work last night and realized I left my laptop charger at the office. Big deal, right? Wrong. It's a Friday afternoon and I need it for tomorrow's presentation. Ugh.

So I call my coworker Sarah and ask her if she has an extra charger lying around. She tells me she doesn't have one, but offers to lend me hers...on one condition: she wants me to come over to her place after work tomorrow and give her a massage. Like, a full-on massage. With oil. And lotion. And maybe some candles burning too. For free. Because, apparently, she's been feeling pretty stressed out lately and needs someone to rub her back.

I'm like, uh, thanks but no thanks. I don't really want to go to someone's house and give them a massage without any compensation. Even if it is my coworker. But then she starts getting all insistent and says she'll only loan me the charger if I agree to do it. And I'm like, okay fine, but only because I desperately need that charger for tomorrow's presentation.
Output: Coworker asks for massage in exchange for laptop charger

Input: Text: this actually happened about 20 minutes ago? so yes, today. (do i get bonus points?)

my hair is currently down to my waist and obviously quite long. i keep putting off getting it cut though, because i haven't found a stylist in my area that i trust enough, so now it's at the point where i'll likely donate a chunk of it and get it styled, because it's so long.

***

***
said in full earshot 

of multiple other employees. 

all the color drained from my face as the words were leaving my mouth. 

i've been looking for a job for months, but that doesn't mean i want to lose my current job before getting a new one...
Output: trying to get my hair cut. might actually be getting my job cut.**

Text: I went to the grocery store yesterday and saw something that made me laugh so hard I almost cried. There was a box of "gluten free" cookies next to a box of regular chocolate chip cookies. The label on the gluten free ones said "made with organic ingredients". The label on the regular ones said "may contain traces of peanuts".

I couldn't help but wonder what kind of person buys gluten free cookies thinking they're healthier, when really they could just be eating plain old sugar cookies instead. And then there are people who buy regular cookies thinking they're safe from peanuts, when really they're just consuming copious amounts of refined carbohydrates. It's like both groups are living in their own little worlds, completely oblivious to each other's dietary choices.

But you know what's even funnier? The fact that I'm probably guilty of both. I mean, I love me some good ole fashioned pasta dough, but I also enjoy indulging in the occasional chocolate chip cookie. So maybe I'm the hypocrite here, laughing at others' dietary mistakes while secretly devouring gluten and peanut products left and right. Oh well, at least I'm consistent. Output: Gluten free vs Regular Cookies

outputs: Text: So I was walking through the park the other day when I saw something that really took me aback. There was a squirrel playing a guitar. Now, I know what you're thinking - how did a squirrel even get its paws on a guitar? But honestly, that's not even the weirdest part. The squirrel was actually pretty good. Like, it was strumming away like a pro. I swear, it was giving me some serious Jimi Hendrix vibes. Needless to say, I was completely blown away by this little ball of fluff. And then, out of nowhere, it stops playing and looks right at me and starts talking. Talking! To me! Like, I know animals communicate with each other and all that, but this was different. It was like it was having a conversation with me. And what does it say to me? Does it say something profound and deep? Nope. It says "Hey, man. Can you hand me another acorn? I'm running low." **And then it winks at me**. Yeah, you read that right. A squirrel played a guitar, stopped mid-song to talk to me, and then asked for another snack. It was like it was messing with me or something. Anyways, that's my crazy animal encounter story. What's yours?

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score.

outputs: Text: I used to have a pet hamster named Mr Snuggles. He was a cute little ball of fluff with big brown eyes and a love for running on his wheel. But one day, disaster struck when my mom accidentally left him outside in the rain. By the time she found him, he was cold, wet, and completely limp. She tried to warm him up with a hair dryer, but unfortunately, it was too late. Poor Mr Snuggles passed away in her arms, leaving me heartbroken and traumatized. To make matters worse, my mom decided to blame ME for his death! Can you believe it? I mean, seriously, how could anyone expect a three year old kid to keep track of a tiny rodent during a rainstorm? It's not exactly something you can put on your to-do list next to brushing your teeth and taking a bath. Anyways, needless to say, I haven't been able to enjoy any pets since then because of course, I'm constantly worried that they might die on me too. So yeah, if you're thinking of getting me a present, maybe avoid anything furry and small for now. Thanks!

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

a friend came with the idea of rockets : dude, i got this really cool project, we need household items and it´s going to be awesome!
we gather the materials, make the mix, cook it and burned it. it was awesome as he said and we make it like 3 times that day.

sooooo, this morning i just wanted to make some fuel. mix the ingredients, ready to cook in my kitchen.
maybe some glasses to look more professional? ok, lets do it.
so, there´s me, heating an inflamable mix.
then, it happens. a huge flame in front of my eyes. i move back and protect me, but it was instantly gone. the smoke covered everything, so i went outside to cough a little when my sister saw me. burned hair, the glasses were black, as my nose and forehead. my hand suffered the most and the house was filled with smoke (wich i didn´t know if it was toxic or not). 
never cooking again by myself.
Output: got burned cooking rocket fuel, filled the house with smoke

Text: So I've been trying to get into this new restaurant downtown for months now, and finally after countless failed attempts at getting reservations, I managed to snag a table last night. And let me tell you, it did NOT disappoint.

Text: I used to be really competitive when it came to video games, especially fighting games. One time I was playing Street Fighter against my friend John, and I got so mad because he kept winning that I threw my controller across the room. It hit the wall and broke into pieces. My mom saw it and freaked out. She told me that if I couldn't handle losing gracefully then maybe I shouldn't play video games anymore.

Since then, I haven't been able to enjoy gaming as much as I used to. Every time I lose, I feel frustrated and angry instead of disappointed or motivated to improve. sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

it was at this moment that i knew i could weave my way out of the situation by just ratting on x and z.

luckily it worked. unluckily they don't want to talk to me ever again.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

we gather the materials, make the mix, cook it and burned it. it was awesome as he said and we make it like 3 times that day.
by this point he tells me that the mix can be used as fuel for rockets.

maybe some glasses to look more professional? ok, lets do it.

never cooking again by myself.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: i was drinking with friends from back home during the holidays like any other get together. we decided to get tequila, so of course we needed limes and a knife to cut them. after a few drinks i challenged my friend that i could cut a lime like fruit ninja if he threw them at me. the friend was concerned someone could get hurt, but i reassured him that i could it. standing about 8 feet apart, he threw the lime at me. i did not even see the lime, i did not even move, and it struck me right in the eye. i immediately had double vision and proceeded to throw up. the following days were met by a swollen eye and continued double vision, which i thought would go away after a few days. it did not. i then went to see a doctor, who said i would require surgery to fix this double vision issue. got the surgery and i still have double vision. the most expensive lime of my life.
Output: told friend to throw a lime at me, it hit me in the eye and i needed surgery to fix it.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: tifu. i was in line at the gas station, waiting to pay for my soda and gas, when i saw a quarter on the packs of gum directly in front of the counter. when it was my turn to pay i bent over and scooped up the quarter, and put it in my pocket, forgetting about it instantly. putting my soda on the counter and reaching for my wallet, i looked up and saw the cashier eyeing me with an angry glare. i was confused by this. was she mad at my choice of soda? (she could be one of those freaks that prefer pepsi) did i have an offensive t shirt on? (not unless she's offended by my obscure podcast shirt) 

i say "......$40 on 2 please." and she responds with "what's in your pocket?" 

"huh?" i stammer before finally understanding. "oh! i didn't steal anything!" and proceed to fervently pull everything out of my pockets, dropping change, and other things. i pick up the 25 cent culprit and thrust it to the cashier, as if it proved my story somehow, and explained that i had just seen the quarter on the gum and nabbed it.

 her face hadn't changed at all during the entire exchange. she finally just completed my transaction and said have a nice day. i'm not sure if she believed me or not, but i gathered all my stuff and hightailed it out of there.
Output: i found a quarter on a display of gum, cashier thought i was blatantly stealing gum right in front of her.

Input: Text: this actually happened about 20 minutes ago? so yes, today. (do i get bonus points?)

my hair is currently down to my waist and obviously quite long. i keep putting off getting it cut though, because i haven't found a stylist in my area that i trust enough, so now it's at the point where i'll likely donate a chunk of it and get it styled, because it's so long.

i, also, currently hate my job and have a job interview on monday, go me! so of course to look more professional, i wanted to get my hair cut before then. (do you know where this is going? of course you do.)

so i'm in the office, sitting at my desk/open cubicle thing, and find a local place to call and try to find an appointment:

***
_m: "hi, i was wondering if you had an appointments available for saturday."_


_salon: "unfortunately we're all booked up, is there another day that would work for you?_


_m: "no, i work during the day [their hours are 9-5 on weekdays], and **i have a job interview on monday**, so i need to get it cut before then._
***
said in full earshot 

of multiple other employees. 

all the color drained from my face as the words were leaving my mouth. 

i've been looking for a job for months, but that doesn't mean i want to lose my current job before getting a new one...
Output: trying to get my hair cut. might actually be getting my job cut.**

Input: Text: obligatory comment about this not actually happening today, and this being a throwaway account.

so like i said, this tifu didn't happen today, but instead happened a little less than a year ago, right before i graduated high school. at the time, i was pretty happy with everything in my life. i was just about to graduate from high school with a decent gpa and sat score, and had already been accepted to the university i wanted to go to. 

with all of this success, i decided it was about time for me to create a professional looking image for myself, which included creating a new email instead of continuing to use the one i made when i was like 12. after making this new email, i switched my phone and computer to only get messages from it, and none from my old email. 

however, in my infinite stupidity, i forgot to change the email i had on my university account to my new one. well around two months later, my parents (who like to be very involved in my life) asked me how much money in scholarships i was going to be getting from the university. i then remembered i had never switched from my old email, and rush to check it. lo and behold, i see 3 or 4 emails from the university telling me to apply for their scholarships, and gradually warning me that the deadline was only getting closer. 

unfortunately for me, i had missed the deadline by a few weeks... and missed out on the 30 grand they offered to students with my sat score. 


 

edit: word choices and better spacing.
Output: created a new email, forgot to switch my university account  from the old one, and obliviously stood by while enough scholarship money to buy a brand new car vaporized into thin air.

We named our business "Flaky Creations" and set up an Instagram page to showcase our products. After posting some pictures of our items, we started receiving orders! People loved our creations and couldn't wait to receive their purchases. However, things took a turn when we realized that we had accidentally listed the wrong prices for our items on our website. Instead of charging $5 for a bracelet, we charged $50! Oops. Needless to say, people weren't too thrilled about paying triple the price for something they thought they were buying for half the cost. We quickly corrected the mistake and apologized profusely to our customers, but the damage had already been done. Our reputation was tarnished, and sales plummeted. Lesson learned? Always double-check your work before launching a successful business venture!

Output: told friend to throw a lime at me, it hit me in the eye and i needed surgery to fix it.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Input:
outputs: Text: I woke up today feeling very hungover from last night's festivities. My head was pounding and my mouth felt like it had been used as an industrial-grade sandblaster. As I stumbled towards the kitchen to grab some aspirin, I noticed something strange - my cat was sitting on top of the fridge, staring intently at something on the floor. Curious, I walked closer to investigate... only to find that my cat had managed to catch a mouse that had somehow made its way into our house! Talk about a hangover cure - I never knew that watching my cat hunt and kill a rodent could be so entertaining. Output: watched my cat catch a mouse while hungover, now i know what to do next time im hungover.

Input: Text: i moved into my apartment in california a little over a year and a half ago, not thinking to see if the place had air conditioning. well, i quickly found out that it didn't and that my room would get hot as shit unless i had the blinds open for air flow. 

so why not just open the blinds?

because i sleep in the buff when it's really hot and more importantly, my neighbors window is directly across from mine. i didnt want to get on any list so i ended up buying one of those cheap tapestries off of amazon to use as a blind that would still let air/some light through but provided cover. i put it up and thought it looked great and just as i had hoped, i wasn't able to see through it. i figured the opposite was true so i opened the blinds and was greeted with a nice warm breeze and haven't adjusted closed the blinds since. 

fast forward to 5 minutes ago when i'm coming home and i realized that i left the light on which i'm usually 100% on. after looking up i realize the tapestry is actually semi-transparent and that got me started on  thinking about how i needed more stuff for my wall since it was pretty plain. 

then it fucking hit me. anyone could see me up there, especially my neighbor. granted, it was a bit blurred, but not anywhere near enough to make me comfortable.
Output: my neighbor probably knows more about my sex life than i do.

Input: Text: well, a little context. i´m the kind of boy who needs to make experiments, to push a little the limits and i can´t stay without making something too much time.
a friend came with the idea of rockets : dude, i got this really cool project, we need household items and it´s going to be awesome!
we gather the materials, make the mix, cook it and burned it. it was awesome as he said and we make it like 3 times that day.
by this point he tells me that the mix can be used as fuel for rockets.
sooooo, this morning i just wanted to make some fuel. mix the ingredients, ready to cook in my kitchen.
maybe some glasses to look more professional? ok, lets do it.
so, there´s me, heating an inflamable mix.
then, it happens. a huge flame in front of my eyes. i move back and protect me, but it was instantly gone. the smoke covered everything, so i went outside to cough a little when my sister saw me. burned hair, the glasses were black, as my nose and forehead. my hand suffered the most and the house was filled with smoke (wich i didn´t know if it was toxic or not). 
never cooking again by myself.
Output: got burned cooking rocket fuel, filled the house with smoke

outputs: Text: I'm sitting here at work, minding my own business, when suddenly I feel a sharp pain in my neck. I try to shake it off, thinking maybe I just strained something, but then I notice that my entire body is covered in hives. My face, my arms, my legs... everywhere. Then I realize... it couldn't be anything else. It's the office cat. Yes, you heard that right. Our office has a cat named Mr. Whiskers, and apparently, he's allergic to me. Like, seriously allergic. So now I'm stuck at my desk, trying to breathe through my mouth while Mr. Whiskers purrs contentedly on his perch behind me, completely unaware of the destruction he's causing. It's like living in a horror movie. Output: Office cat causes severe allergic reaction

outputs: Text: I was at work today when suddenly I felt a sharp pain in my side. At first, I thought maybe I had just twisted wrong while lifting something, but then I realized I couldn't breathe properly. I started panicking and tried to sit down, but I could barely stand up straight. My vision began to blur and I knew something was seriously wrong. Apparently, it happened because I sat in the same position for too long during a meeting earlier that day. Lesson learned - take breaks and don't sit for extended periods of time! Edit: Thanks everyone for your concern! I'm doing okay now, just taking things easy for a bit.

Input:
outputs: Text: So I just watched an episode of "The Great British Baking Show" where a contestant made a cake with edible gold leaf. My mind is blown by the fact that someone would put something so ridiculously fancy into a dessert meant to be consumed. Like, who does that? It's not even a special occasion! Why go through the extra effort when you could just make a normal cake? And then I realized...I do that every time I write a blog post. I spend hours crafting each sentence, making sure everything flows perfectly, and adding unnecessary details just to make it more interesting. And then I hit publish and realize...it's just a blog post. Who cares? But then I get nervous that no one will read it and I'll look foolish. So I share it on social media hoping people will see it and maybe leave a comment. And if nobody comments, I start to doubt myself and wonder if I'm actually any good at this writing thing. Ugh. Output: Realized I'm just like the GBBS contestants, but instead of gold leaf, I use words.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.

Input: Text: so to give my background, i go to a small liberal arts college in a freezing state.  since it's january we don't have much to do except well...drink.  now my buddies and i have a tradition, during the month of january we have a bucket list that's filled with debauchery.  from stealing tables in the cafeteria, getting peed of by someone or plain ole streaking, we have it all.

last night we were all kicking back having some delicious hamm's special light and i get the idea "hey i want to complete an item of the bucket list!" i get my phone out and scroll through the list till i reach [get hair cut by opposing team member.]  i think to myself "this is made for me!" i tell the boys at the party, which had around 30 or so people by this point and they get out the clippers.  after a few short minutes and everyone taking a swipe at my hair i end up with two mohawks, and not just any mohawks but the most uneven, messed up mohawks in my life.

i woke up this morning to go to work, i work as a tour guide, and the first thing my boss tells me to do is take off my hat.  she sees my hair and tells me how unprofessional i am and gives me a warning...and now i have to give a tour...well shit
Output: got drunk, let my friends cut my hair while they are drunk, now i look like a who from whoville.

Input: Text: so today was my sister's birthday party, a lot of my family was there, probably around 30 people or so. so my 7 year old nephew was talking about riding his bike and i proceed to tell him how awesome i used to be on a bmx. 
a little while later i put my money with my mouth is, jump on his bike and immediately start riding a wheelie. got about 15 feet and pulled to hard on the bike and flipped it. 

instantly i knew something was wrong. i landed on my butt/lowerback and couldn't move much at all. within 30 seconds i have my whole family and a bunch of the neighborhood kids standing around me freaking out. at this point i am going into shock and trying my best not to pass out. i eventually(with some help) managed to stand up. i tried telling everyone i was fine and not to call an ambulance, they did anyways. when they got there, i'm feeling a little better, but still trying not to feint from the pain. i ended up turning the ambulance away and having my brother drive me to the hospital, do to me not being insured. 

5 hours later a plethora of xrays and a catscan that is going to cost me probably around 6k, i find out i broke my back(compression fracture of my l5 vertebrae). now i'm home laying here in pain and unable to sleep.

 

sorry if my grammar and typing are a little off, i'm not the best.
Output: , tried showing off to a bunch of kids, broke my back and bruised my ego.
